title: PAP Therapy Equipment Pickup Lead Time and Recovery Charges Schedule
content:
# PAP Therapy Equipment Pickup Lead Time and Recovery Charges

When a rented PAP Therapy Equipment device comes back, the class fixes the business days after the patient confirms the return within which the pickup is scheduled, the calendar days after the confirmed pickup date after which a device still not recovered is charged to the patient, the charge for a rented device not recovered, and the charge for a rented device recovered damaged beyond normal wear.

| Device class | Pickup lead (business days) | Not recovered after (days past the confirmed pickup date) | Charge for a device not recovered (USD) | Damage beyond normal wear (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 0 | 0 (never picked up) | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 5 | 30 | 650.00 | 150.00 |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 5 | 30 | 750.00 | 150.00 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 5 | 30 | 1400.00 | 250.00 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 5 | 30 | 3200.00 | 400.00 |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 5 | 30 | 3900.00 | 400.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The Travel CPAP System (E0601) is sold self-pay and is never picked up, so every figure on its row is 0.
- The not-recovered count runs in calendar days after the confirmed pickup date; the pickup lead runs in business days, Monday to Friday excluding Summit Ridge holidays, after the patient's confirmation.

**Example (hypothetical dates).** For an Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) whose confirmed pickup date is 2 June, a device still not recovered on 2 July, 30 days after that date, is charged 750.00.
